name: writing
title: Writing — a nine-stage research-and-drafting process, 8 roles, a voice guide

skillsAndAutomations.reason: The pack ships no slash command, no skill and no hook. The source project's only hook was a third-party notifier belonging to an unrelated tool, and its permission allowlist was roughly 120 accreted, project-specific entries; migrating either would ship one project's history as another project's defaults. The two rules this pack most needs automated — never overwrite a draft, append a row to index.md — are carried by prose in CLAUDE.md instead. Closing this part is writing@1.1 work.

autonomyContract.reason: The pack has no target contract, no readiness gate, no autonomy envelope, no abort criteria, no work log and no SUCCESS/ABORT termination. What it has instead is a supervision posture — no auto-chaining, and publishing is unconditionally human-gated — which says what an agent may not do alone rather than what it may do alone and how it stops. Closing this part means gaining the targets contract, which is writing@1.1 work.
